columnDefinitions.meaning: The exact named product a buyer would purchase or subscribe to.
The broad market category this product belongs to.
The specific tech features or sub-topics inside the category.
The quarter & year this product first entered the market.
How mature this product is today on the adoption curve.
A number from 1–4 showing maturity. 4 = most mature, 1 = newest.

lifecycleStages.meaning: The category leader. Everyone else follows its lead. Switching away is costly.
Widely used across companies. Proven, stable, with a healthy partner ecosystem.
Growing fast and grabbing market share. Feature releases are frequent. Still maturing.
Brand new to the market. Exciting but unproven. Standards are not set yet.
